content.json:
# CatCar Operations Dashboard
Operational health and work-order flow telemetry from Application Insights.

content.title: Daily Work Order Volume
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'WorkOrderOpened'
| summarize WorkOrders = count() by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by Day asc

content.title: Average Execution Time per Status
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'WorkOrderStatusChanged'
| extend Status = tostring(customDimensions.status), ExecutionTimeMs = todouble(customMeasurements.executionTimeMs)
| where isnotempty(Status) and isnotnull(ExecutionTimeMs)
| summarize AverageExecutionTimeMs = round(avg(ExecutionTimeMs), 2) by Status
| order by AverageExecutionTimeMs desc

content.title: Integration Error Rates
content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions['EventType'] == 'IntegrationEvent'
| extend Outcome = tostring(customDimensions['Outcome']), EventName = tostring(customDimensions['EventName'])
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(Outcome == 'Failed') by EventName, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend ErrorRatePercent = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 2))
| project timestamp, EventName, ErrorRatePercent
| order by timestamp asc
